\section{Reproducibility instructions}\label{app:reproducibility}

From the manuscript directory, generate and verify the rational record with
\begin{verbatim}
python3 supplement/exact_enclosures.py
python3 supplement/verify_certificate.py
python3 -m unittest supplement.test_heat_kernel_enclosures -v
\end{verbatim}
Only the Python standard library is required.  Compile the paper with
\begin{verbatim}
latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error \
  -outdir=build main.tex
\end{verbatim}
The release archive contains the source, bibliography, rational record,
generator, checker, tests, build report, and PDF.  The exact release is
identified by the SHA-256 sidecar stored beside the archive.  The code is
provided under the MIT license; the manuscript notice reserves its text
separately.
